identity.name: Identity cards
identity.description: Identity or membership cards that name a card holder; they show a card number, the holder's name and an expiry date, sometimes split across a front and a back side.
identity.original_instruction: For any identity card I send, give me the card number, the holder's full name and the expiry date exactly as printed.

fields.label: Card number
fields.description: The card's number or code exactly as printed, including letters and separators.

fields.label: Holder name
fields.description: Full name of the person the card belongs to, as printed.

fields.label: Expiry date
fields.description: The date until which the card is valid, exactly as printed.

invoice.name: Supplier invoices
invoice.description: Invoices that request payment for goods or services; they carry an invoice number, an invoice date, the selling party, the amount due and itemized lines.
invoice.original_instruction: From supplier invoices take the invoice number, invoice date, seller, amount due, and for every item line its description, quantity and line total.

fields.label: Invoice number
fields.description: Invoice number or code exactly as printed.

fields.label: Invoice date
fields.description: Date the invoice was issued, as printed.

fields.label: Seller
fields.description: Name of the business that issued the invoice.

fields.label: Amount due
fields.description: Total amount to pay, including the printed currency sign or code.

fields.label: Line items
fields.description: Each itemized line in document order; exclude headings and totals.

columns.label: Item description
columns.description: Name or description of the item on that line.

columns.label: Line total
columns.description: Amount printed for that line, as printed.

receipt.name: Shop receipts
receipt.description: Receipts handed out by shops or cafes after a purchase; they show the store, the date of purchase, the total paid and usually a receipt number.
receipt.original_instruction: Read my shop receipts: store name, purchase date, total paid and the receipt number.

fields.label: Store
fields.description: Name of the shop or cafe.

fields.label: Purchase date
fields.description: Date of the purchase as printed.

fields.label: Total paid
fields.description: Total amount paid, as printed with its currency.

fields.label: Receipt number
fields.description: Receipt or check number, if the receipt shows one.

receipt_twin.name: Purchase slips
receipt_twin.description: Proof-of-payment slips from shops and cafes that state where and when something was bought, the amount paid and a slip number.
receipt_twin.original_instruction: For purchase slips from shops, extract the store, the purchase date, the total paid and the slip number.

fields.label: Store
fields.description: Name of the shop or cafe.

fields.label: Purchase date
fields.description: Date of the purchase as printed.

fields.label: Total paid
fields.description: Total amount paid, as printed with its currency.

fields.label: Slip number
fields.description: Slip or check number, if one is printed.

certificate.name: Course certificates
certificate.description: Certificates confirming that a person completed a course or training; they name the recipient, the course, the issue date and a certificate code.
certificate.original_instruction: From course certificates extract the certificate code, the recipient's name, the course title and the issue date.

fields.label: Certificate code
fields.description: Certificate number or code as printed.

fields.label: Recipient
fields.description: Name of the person who received the certificate.

fields.label: Course title
fields.description: Title of the completed course or training.

fields.label: Issue date
fields.description: Date the certificate was issued, as printed.

contract.name: Service agreements
contract.description: Agreements between a client and a service provider; they carry an agreement number, both parties and the date from which the agreement is effective.
contract.original_instruction: For service agreements give me the agreement number, the client, the provider and the effective date.

fields.label: Agreement number
fields.description: Agreement number as printed.

fields.label: Client
fields.description: The party ordering the service.

fields.label: Provider
fields.description: The party providing the service.

fields.label: Effective date
fields.description: Date from which the agreement applies, as printed.

application.name: Service application forms
application.description: Filled-in forms in which an applicant requests a service; they show an application number, the applicant, the requested service and the submission date.
application.original_instruction: From application forms extract the application number, applicant name, requested service and submission date.

fields.label: Application number
fields.description: Application or request number as printed.

fields.label: Applicant
fields.description: Name of the person who filled in the form.

fields.label: Requested service
fields.description: The service the applicant asks for, as written.

fields.label: Submission date
fields.description: Date the form was submitted, as printed.

letter.name: Official letters
letter.description: Letters from an organization to a recipient with a reference number, an addressee, a subject line and a date.
letter.original_instruction: For incoming letters capture the reference number, the addressee, the subject line and the letter date.

fields.label: Reference
fields.description: The sender's reference or outgoing number, if printed.

fields.label: Addressee
fields.description: Person or office the letter is addressed to.

fields.label: Subject line
fields.description: The subject line of the letter.

fields.label: Letter date
fields.description: Date of the letter as printed.

repeating_rows.name: Delivery registers
repeating_rows.description: Registers or logs that list many similar entries, each with a code, a text and a count, under a register code and a period.
repeating_rows.original_instruction: From delivery registers extract the register code and period and every entry with its code, text and count, in order.

fields.label: Register code
fields.description: Code or number of the register.

fields.label: Period
fields.description: Period the register covers, as printed.

fields.label: Entries
fields.description: Every register entry in document order, including entries continued from a previous page.
